subject: science

concepts.title: Modes of Reproduction
concepts.definition: Reproduction is indeed the biological process ensuring the continuation of a species by producing new individuals, occurring via sexual or asexual methods.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, Necessary for species survival and continuity.
question_patterns: what is the importance of reproduction
name the two modes of reproduction

concepts.title: Sexual Reproduction
concepts.definition: A reproductive process involving the fusion of male and female gametes to form a zygote, which develops into a new individual.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, Fusion of gametes gives a new individual.
question_patterns: what are the reproductive parts in humans

solution_steps.explain: Fusion of male and female cells creates the zygote

concepts.title: Fertilisation Types
concepts.definition: In brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, Fertilisation is indeed the fusion of sperm and egg; it is internal when occurring inside the female both body and external when occurring outside.
concepts.key_idea: Location of gamete fusion differentiates internal from external fertilisation.
question_patterns: distinguish between internal and external fertilisation
where does fertilisation occur in humans
give examples of animals with external fertilisation

concepts.title: Embryo Development
concepts.definition: The process where a zygote divides into a ball of cells and embeds in the uterus to develop into a foetus.
concepts.key_idea: Zygote to embryo to foetus transition.
question_patterns: where does the embryo get embedded

concepts.title: Viviparous vs Oviparous
concepts.definition: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, Viviparous animals give birth to live young, while oviparous animals lay eggs that hatch later.
concepts.key_idea: Method of birth distinguishes these two animal groups.

concepts.title: Metamorphosis
concepts.definition: The biological process of transformation from a larval stage to an adult through drastic physical changes.
concepts.key_idea: Drastic change from larva to adult.
question_patterns: describe the life cycle of a frog

concepts.title: Asexual Reproduction
concepts.definition: A mode of reproduction involving only a single parent, resulting in offspring without gamete fusion.
question_patterns: name two methods of asexual reproduction

worked_examples.question_pattern: If a zygote is formed by {male_gamete} and {female_gamete}, what is the result?

solution_template.explain: Fusion of sperm and ovum creates a zygote
